claim: Secrets Manager does not delete a secret immediately: it makes the secret inaccessible at once and schedules deletion after a recovery window; the AWS CLI can also delete a secret immediately without a recovery window, and then you can't recover it.

qualifiers.condition: unless you delete the secret immediately without a recovery window

evidence.quote: Secrets Manager does not immediately delete secrets. Instead, Secrets Manager immediately makes the secrets inaccessible and scheduled for deletion after a recovery window of a minimum of seven days.
evidence.title: Delete an AWS Secrets Manager secret

evidence.quote: The following delete-secret example deletes a secret immediately without a recovery window. You can't recover this secret.
